decisions.reason: The source changes the qualification deliverable before ticket creation but does not alter the subsequent quota of 125 approved clips per month.

The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete three-clip batch-source constraint. The reference is an editing example, not necessarily a replacement source for the clip footage, so no additional change is entailed.
Reducing the corrective qualification submission to one reference-matching clip does not change the requirement that a clip contain a complete standalone lesson or story.
The instruction to match a supplied reference does not explicitly replace or alter the existing white-caption, prescribed-font, and no-caption-effects rules.
The source changes the number and reference-matching condition of the qualification submission but does not alter the standard for selecting strong, impactful source moments.
Matching the provided reference for the corrective clip does not explicitly modify the existing clean, simple, no-effects, and no-transitions editing standard.
The source changes the qualification clip count and matching condition but states no new duration range and does not cancel the existing 30–90-second requirement.
